featured_reviews.review_text:
I am writing to share my deepest appreciation for the exemplary service, professionalism, and profound empathy demonstrated by the team at your Clare Road branch in Mumbai—specifically Branch Manager Mr. Pramod, my Relationship Manager Mr. Faisal, and Ms. Minal Parab.

Losing my mother earlier this year was an incredibly difficult emotional experience, and being based in Singapore, I was completely clueless and overwhelmed about how to handle the closure of my Mother's resident savings bank account from abroad.

From my very first remote interaction, Mr. Pramod and Mr. Faisal completely eased my anxieties. They guided me step-by-step while I was still in Singapore, reassuring me that they would manage the logistics and ensure all proceeds were seamlessly transferred to my NRO account. True to their word, they promised to handle everything the moment I arrived in Mumbai this June.

When I walked into the Clare Road branch, the team’s warmth was palpable. They genuinely understood the grief I was going through and treated me with the utmost dignity and respect. What I expected to be a tedious, stressful process was handled with absolute precision; Faisal and Minal had everything prepared, and I was out of the bank in just 20 minutes with all formalities successfully completed.

In a world where banking is increasingly transactional, Mr. Pramod, Faisal, and Minal redefined what true customer care looks like. They combined seamless professional efficiency with genuine human compassion.

Please convey my sincere gratitude to the Clare Road team. They are a stellar asset to DCB Bank, and because of them, my trust in your institution is higher than ever.

Warm regards,

Khozem

featured_reviews.name: hemavati kannan
featured_reviews.review_text:
I recently visited the SBI main branch for my education loan application, carrying a solid university conditional offer letter in print — not just an email on my phone. I reached the branch even before opening hours and ended up spending over 15 hours in total, including travel from my home as it’s far, only to be turned away after 5 PM with no progress.

Me and my mum had taken an informed last-minute leave from work and carried every required document — passport Xerox, marksheets, bank statements, identity proofs, bills, tax receipts, co-applicant documents, asset-liability papers, and more — expecting a smooth process. However, after a full day of documentation, the manager informed me that SBI does not accept conditional offer letters, only unconditional ones. This crucial requirement was never communicated earlier.

To make matters worse, the manager was unwilling to acknowledge that other banks are already processing loans based on conditional letters — something I know from my friends' and relatives' experiences. She insisted this was an "internal SBI rule" and that 15% of the fees must be paid by the applicant upfront even the semester fees will be paid by us later they will do the reimbursement . I was also told that even the portion of the loan for travel or accommodation would only be disbursed via a refillable card which i can swipe only in big stores, not in cash or to my account.

What felt particularly dismissive was her sarcastic comment questioning, "Who includes in loan for 20, 40 rupaiya stay travel expenses?" — a clear lack of understanding of real student expenses in abroad. Despite knowing SBI’s bad reputation for inefficiency, I gave it a try and ended up wasting my time, energy, and peace of mind. I didn’t create a chaos i smiled and left.

I was even told to open a new SBI account and pay Rs. 2000 for a "mandatory" insurance, which is now completely useless to me as I no longer wish to continue with SBI.

This experience left me feeling like a complete joke — i might be wrong somewhere but not everywhere as i went to that bank with open mind of learning understanding the process rules and everything in between. Despite being fully prepared, I was made to run around for hours only to be rejected due to an arbitrary rule that wasn't mentioned beforehand. Overall, a deeply frustrating and disappointing experience. I would not recommend SBI to any student seeking an education loan
